soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown from the marginal teeth to the tip, the posterior half deep yellow, labrum yellow with the anterior third transparent pale yellow, anteclypeus milky white, postclypeus deeper than the head, antennae deep yellow, pronotum yellow and deeper in its anterior half, legs and abdomen pale yellow. The head has only several long hairs, the postclypeus four short hairs, the middle of the labrum with four pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows; the pronotum with long and short hairs alternating, its posterior margin with only several left-right symmetrical long hairs. Head nearly circular, slightly wider than long, the posterior margin arcuate and projecting; labrum tongue-shaped, slightly longer than wide, the sides behind the middle arcuately convex; the front of the mandibles forming a large hook, the tip fine and sharp, each with one inner marginal tooth behind the midpoint, the marginal tooth of the left mandible slightly larger than that of the right; postmentum short and stout, its sides concave inwards near the tip. Antennae with 14 segments, the fourth shortest, the second longer than the third. Pronotum constricted at the middle, the middle of the anterior margin with a V-shaped concavity, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi with four segments.
